summary: Phase 1 (Settings + PIN lock + Categories + Recurring + Bills) end-to-end verified on mobile viewport 390x844 against public URL. All 9 review bullets pass: Home base, gear-to-settings, PIN set/wrong/correct/remove, lock on reload, Palestra custom category created, income recurring created + pause toggle shows 'In pausa', bill 'Luce' €50 due in 2d appears in home banner as 'Scade fra 2g', Paga decreases saldo to -€50,00 and banner disappears, AsyncStorage persists after reload.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely in a 3rd-party dep (bottom-sheet/safe-area) or local component. Non-blocking.

action_items: Trace source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning and migrate to style.pointerEvents to clear console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: security.ts/setPin stores PIN; ensure hashing (SHA-256 or similar) rather than plaintext in AsyncStorage. (Not verified by UI tests)
RecurringSheet rec-cat-salary selector was clickable in tests, confirming built-in category 'salary' exists; good.
BillSheet validates YYYY-MM-DD only; a native date picker could improve UX but spec expects plain TextInput.
seed_data_creation: Within AsyncStorage: 1 custom category (Palestra), 1 recurring rule (income 1500 monthly from main, paused), 1 bill (Luce €50 monthly). PIN was set and later removed by test. localStorage was cleared at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://wallet-tracker-278.preview.emergentagent.com. On web, isBiometricSupported()=false so toggle-biometric stays disabled by design. Clear localStorage before PIN tests to avoid stale lock state. All testIDs behave as specified.
rca_of_issue: No bugs detected during this iteration.
